summary: Materialise NV filed a Form 6-K with its half-year report for the six months ended June 30, 2026, per Belgian law. The filing includes unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements and non-IFRS measures such as Adjusted EBITDA. This is a routine periodic financial report, not a special-situation event. No M&A, activist, restructuring, or other corporate action is disclosed. The filing serves as an update on ordinary business performance and financial condition, with no deal terms or transactional mechanics. What to watch: ongoing operational results and any future strategic announcements.
